from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and its citation relationships to OTHER provided papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its bibliography")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that explicitly cite this paper in their works")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
